mechanism: Both drugs increase CNS stimulation and excitability through different pathways (amphetamine via monoamine release; perampanel via AMPA receptor antagonism), with potential additive effects on seizure threshold and psychomotor effects.
action: Monitor for increased CNS side effects, behavioral changes, and seizure control; dose adjustments may be necessary; use caution in patients with seizure disorders as amphetamine can lower seizure threshold.
